newsitem.title: UK: UK's Conran Group to launch new cafe chain - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Conran Group to launch new cafe chain - paper.

text.p: The UK's Conran Group plans to open a new chain affordable French-style eateries and may seek a listing on the UK's Alternative Investment Market to fund it, the Independent on Sunday said.
The first outlet of the chain, to be called the Zinc Bar and Grill, will open next year in the West End of London, the paper said, quoting a spokeswoman from the Conran Group.
The paper said the group might tap financial markets through a listing on the AIM.
The company was immediately unavailable for comment.
